annotations.title: Base64 / data URI to image file

description: Decode Base64 back into a file: accepts a data URI, a CSS url("data:…") rule, an tag, URL-encoded SVG data URIs, or raw Base64 (standard or URL-safe, line breaks allowed). Detects the real type from the bytes, warns when it differs from the declared one, and writes decoded.. Give the text inline or as a path to a text file. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/image-to-base64/

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

path.description: Or: a text file containing it.

text.description: The data URI / CSS / tag / raw Base64.

name: image_from_base64
title: Base64 / data URI to image file
